faqs.question: Can it post for me?
faqs.answer: Yes, to your connected Facebook Page or Instagram Business account, when you ask it to. Instagram posts need an image.

faqs.question: Can it schedule my posts?
faqs.answer: No. It posts when you ask. A schedule can send you a reminder, like "Post the Tuesday reel", by email or WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can it design inside Canva?
faqs.answer: No. It can find your designs, export them, upload images and fill your brand templates. It can't edit inside a design.

faqs.question: Can it make videos?
faqs.answer: It can trim and convert your videos and pull the audio out of them. It doesn't make new videos from text.

faqs.question: Can someone work on it with me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share one AI chat with up to 3 people using Share Grid, or send them a read-only link.

faqs.question: Is it free to start?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sign up with your email. Top up only when you need more.

plainEnglishHeading: What it can do, in plain English
plainEnglish: Classgrid AI helps you make content faster. You tell it what you make and who it is for, and it helps with the rest. It plans, writes, makes images and posts for you. Everything happens in one chat.

Ask it to plan your content for the week. It gives you a day-by-day plan with a topic and a format for each day, like a reel, a post or a short. It also writes the hook and the caption for each one. Each caption comes in a box you can copy with one click.

You can teach it how you talk. In Skills, tell it how you want it to write, like fun and short, or simple and friendly. It uses that style every time it writes for you. If you say "remember this", it can save it for next time.

Need a thumbnail or a poster? Describe it, and the agent makes the image for you. You can download it and use it right away. Text inside a made image can come out wrong, so it's best to add your title yourself.

The agent can work with your video files too. It can cut a clip down to the part you want, change it to another format, or pull the sound out as an MP3. It can also turn a voice note into text. You don't need to install any editing software.

Connect your Facebook Page or Instagram Business account. When you ask, the agent publishes a post for you. Instagram posts need an image. It does not post on its own or at a set time, but a schedule can send you a reminder to post.

It can read the comments on your posts and help you reply to them. It can also read your Page messages and pull your insights, like reach and reactions. On YouTube it can search videos, check your channel stats and read comments. This helps you see what your audience likes.

If you use Canva, the agent can find your designs and export them as PNG, PDF or MP4. It can upload images and fill your brand templates, but it can't edit inside a design. It can also find and save files in Google Drive and keep your plans in Notion.

Making content with someone else? Share one AI chat with up to 3 other people using Share Grid, and each person's messages are tagged with their name. You can also share a finished chat as a read-only link on WhatsApp or LinkedIn. It is free to start, and you top up only when you need more.
